title: 0 COB in calculator during Graph calculation
symptom: When a bolus reminder is raised after entering carbs, opening the Calculator may show 0 COB because graph calculation is still in progress, leading to incorrect bolus calculation.
cause: When history data is updated (e.g., smoothed BG values), all precalculated data from that time is invalidated and new calculation must be done, including COB.
fix: No fix implemented; maintainer suggests possibly showing a message in dialog 'still waiting for COB calculation'.
evidence_quote: when history data is updated, for example smoothed BG values, all precalculated data from that time is invalidated and new calculation must be done. including COB.
